lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A prominent series of six large, high-luminance circular blobs is arranged in a roughly horizontal linear configuration mid-flank, posterior to the gill slits. A secondary row of smaller, more densely packed blobs is situated ventrally to this primary row.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Approximately seven vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal blob rows, creating a distinct rectilinear grid of high-luminance anchor nodes across the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a high-contrast vertical luminance gradient (highlighted upper edge, shadowed lower edge) extending from the dorsal gill region toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a scattered distribution of approximately 15 small high-luminance blobs, with a higher spatial concentration observed in the posterior-basal quadrant of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, irregular V-shaped notch is visible on the upper trailing edge of the first dorsal fin, indicating physical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region exhibits a high-density distribution of micro-scale high-luminance spots. Several elongated, dark-toned silhouettes are attached to the ventral surface near the pectoral fin and caudal peduncle.
